defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively before a known burst of damage or a tankbuster cleave to reduce all damage taken by 40% for 8 seconds.

defensives.name: Earth Elemental
defensives.usage_rule: Summon to soak a major hit or off-tank an add; it also grants you a sizeable health buffer and can be used defensively on a long cooldown.

defensives.name: Stone Bulwark Totem
defensives.usage_rule: When talented, drop before incoming damage to gain a recurring physical and magical absorb shield; use it on cooldown during damage-heavy phases.

defensives.name: Spirit Walk
defensives.usage_rule: Use to remove movement-impairing effects and gain a burst of speed to reach mechanics or close back into melee range quickly.

defensives.name: Healing Surge
defensives.usage_rule: Spend 5 or more Maelstrom Weapon stacks to cast an instant self-heal when you drop low; the cooldown listed is a soft pacing value since this is gated by Maelstrom rather than a real cooldown.
